units.source_text: 柏木卫门督现在还独居在父亲邸宅的东厢里。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, was still living alone in the east wing of his father's mansion.

units.source_text: 他意欲娶妻，而志望高远，因此至今还是独身。

en.t: He wished to take a wife, but his hopes were so high that he remained unmarried even now.

units.source_text: 这虽是自作自受，非关别人，但总不免寂寞无聊。

en.t: Although this was his own doing and no one else's fault, he could not help feeling lonely and bored.

units.source_text: 然而他很自负，常思自己有此地位与才貌，

en.t: Yet he was very proud, often thinking that with his rank, talents, and looks,
why should he worry that he could not fulfill his long-cherished wish?

units.source_text: 但自那天傍晚窥见那人面影之后，心情十分颓丧，只管耽于沉思。

en.t: But ever since he glimpsed that person's face that evening, his spirits had sunk deeply, and he did nothing but lose himself in thought.

units.source_text: 他总想找个机会，再见那人一面，即使像前次那样隐约窥见也好。

en.t: He kept longing for a chance to see that person once more, even if only as faintly as he had the last time.

units.source_text: 照他的身份，行动不会受人注目，只须找个小小借口，

en.t: Given his status, his movements would not attract notice; he only needed to find some small pretext,

units.source_text: 例如斋戒礼佛、趋避凶神等事由，便可随意出门。

en.t: such as fasting and praying to the Buddha, or avoiding an unlucky deity, and he could go out whenever he liked.

units.source_text: 那时自然可以巧觅机缘，接近芳踪。

en.t: Then he would surely be able to seek out a suitable opportunity and draw near to her traces.

units.source_text: 又念那人身居不可想象的深闺之中，

en.t: Then he thought again that she lived hidden away in an unimaginably secluded inner chamber,

units.source_text: 我即使但望把刻骨相思之情向她诉说，又有什么办法呢？

en.t: and even if I only wished to tell her of this love that has pierced me to the bone, what means would I have?

units.source_text: 他心中苦闷万状，便照例写信给那侍女小侍从。

en.t: Tormented beyond measure, he wrote as usual to the lady-in-waiting, Ko Jijū.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“前日赖有春风引导，幸得瞻仰芳园，窃窥帘底。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "The other day, guided by the spring breeze, I was fortunate enough to behold the fragrant garden and secretly glimpse beneath the blinds.

units.source_text: 但不知公主将如何斥我为轻薄之人。

en.t: Yet I do not know how the princess will condemn me as a frivolous man.

units.source_text: 惟小生自是晚以来，即患心病，真所谓‘不知缘底事，想望到如今’也。”

en.t: Only, since that evening, I have been stricken with a sickness of the heart; truly it is as the poem says, 'not knowing why, I have yearned until now.'"
He also sent a poem, saying:
